cohort: The study included 740 neonates admitted to Jimma Medical Center over a period of 4 years.
finding: The magnitude of perinatal asphyxia was 18%, and it was significantly associated with prolonged labor, primiparity, birth size (SGA and LGA), mode of delivery, and APGAR score at 1st minute.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was identified as a significant factor associated with perinatal asphyxia.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from neonates admitted over a period of 4 years.
